title: annealer class order
description: Order of the classes in static `class` attributes. A class is ranked by the CSS properties it sets: classes no rule matches first (or last, see `unknown`), then by variants, then by the first differing property in `propertyOrder`, then by the number of properties (more first), then by name with runs of digits compared as numbers. This is the comparison Tailwind CSS uses for its official order.

unknown.description: Where classes that no rule matches go, in source order.

removeDuplicates.description: Drop repeated classes, keeping the first.

important.description: Marker for important utilities, stripped from the start or end of the utility before matching (`!` for Tailwind's `!p-4` and `p-4!`).

arbitraryProperties.description: Classes of the form `[property:value]` set `property` (Tailwind's arbitrary properties).

variants.description: Variant prefixes (`md:`, `hover:`). Omit when classes have none. A class with an unknown variant is unknown.

separator.description: Separates variants from each other and from the utility, outside `[]` and `()`.

order.description: Variant patterns by rank, lowest first. An entry that is a list gives its patterns the same rank. Classes without variants come first; otherwise the highest rank among a class's variants decides, then the next one, like comparing bit masks.

propertyOrder.description: CSS properties in output order. Rules may only name properties listed here.

values.description: Named value sets, used as `{name}` in rule patterns. Entries are patterns without value sets. `number` (a decimal number such as `4` or `0.5`) is built in.

rules.description: Which properties each class sets. The most specific matching pattern wins: an exact name, then the most literal characters, then the most value sets; the first listed wins ties. A modifier after `/` (`bg-red-500/50`) is ignored when the class without it matches better.

match.description: Class patterns: `*` matches any run of characters, `{name}` one entry of a value set.

properties.description: The properties the classes set, from `propertyOrder`.

count.description: Number of declarations the classes emit, when it differs from the number of `properties`. Breaks ties: more first.
